units.source_text: “乡下人反而比城里人更坏。

en.t: “Country people are actually worse than city people.

units.source_text: 你刚才说，你的亲戚中好像没有什么坏人。

en.t: Just now you said there did not seem to be any especially bad people among your relatives.

units.source_text: 难道说，你认为世上会有一种叫做坏人的人吗？

en.t: Do you really think there is a kind of person in the world called a bad person?

units.source_text: 那种用模子刻出来的坏人，世上当然是没有的。

en.t: Of course there are no bad people in the world who have been stamped out of a mold like that.

units.source_text: 平时都是好人，至少是一般人，

en.t: In ordinary times, everyone is a good person, or at least an ordinary person,

units.source_text: 可是一到关键时刻，有可能突然变成坏人，所以才可怕。

en.t: but when the crucial moment comes, they may suddenly turn into bad people, and that is what makes them frightening.

units.source_text: 因此绝不能掉以轻心。”

en.t: That is why one must never let down one’s guard.”

units.source_text: 先生还想继续说下去，我也想说点什么。

en.t: Sensei seemed ready to go on speaking, and I too wanted to say something.

units.source_text: 这时，突然听到身后传来狗叫声，

en.t: Just then, we suddenly heard a dog barking behind us,

units.source_text: 先生和我都吃了一惊，回过身去。

en.t: and both Sensei and I started in surprise and turned around.

units.source_text: 从缘台旁边到后面都种着杉树苗，

en.t: Cedar saplings had been planted from beside the veranda bench around toward the back,

units.source_text: 杉树苗旁边长着一片茂密的山白竹，遮盖了大约三坪的土地。

en.t: and beside the saplings a thick growth of dwarf bamboo covered about three tsubo of ground.

units.source_text: 一只狗从山白竹上面探出脑袋和脊背，汪汪地叫着。

en.t: A dog showed its head and back above the bamboo and barked loudly.

units.source_text: 这时候，一个十岁上下的孩子跑过来喝住了狗。

en.t: At that moment, a child of about ten ran over and scolded the dog into silence.

units.source_text: 孩子头戴一顶有帽徽的黑帽子，

en.t: The child wore a black cap with a badge on it,

units.source_text: 绕到先生面前，戴着帽子鞠了个躬，问道：

en.t: came around in front of Sensei, bowed without removing the cap, and asked:

units.source_text: “叔叔，你进来的时候，屋子里没有人吗？”

en.t: “Uncle, when you came in, was there no one in the house?”

units.source_text: “一个人也没有啊。”

en.t: “There was no one at all.”

units.source_text: “可是姐姐和妈妈都在厨房里呀。”

en.t: “But my sister and mother were both in the kitchen.”

units.source_text: “哦，在家啊！”

en.t: “Oh, they were home!”

units.source_text: “是啊。叔叔，要是打个招呼，再进来就好了。”

en.t: “Yes. Uncle, you should have called out before coming in.”

units.source_text: 先生苦笑了一下，从怀里取出钱包，

en.t: Sensei gave a wry smile and took a purse from inside his kimono,

units.source_text: 拿出一枚五钱的白铜币塞在小孩手里。

en.t: then took out a five-sen nickel coin and pressed it into the child’s hand.

units.source_text: “告诉你妈妈一声，让我们在这儿歇一会儿。”

en.t: “Tell your mother for us that we will rest here for a little while.”

units.source_text: 小孩机灵的眼睛里满含着笑，对我们点点头。

en.t: The child’s clever eyes brimmed with a smile, and he nodded to us.
